code: local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local RunS=game:GetService('RunService') for _,g in ipairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do if g:IsA('ScreenGui') then g.Enabled=false end end local Pose=require(RS.Shared.Pose) local FM=require(RS.Shared.FieldMotion) local c=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character if c and c:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') then c.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored=true c:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0,-200,0)) end local folder=Instance.new('Folder') folder.Name='MotionLab' folder.Parent=workspace local floor=Instance.new('Part') floor.Anchored=true floor.Size=Vector3.new(80,1,80) floor.Position=Vector3.new(0,-0.5,0) floor.Color=Color3.fromRGB(150,140,120) floor.Parent=folder local rng=Random.new(5) local walker=Pose.createR15(folder,Vector3.new(-9,0,0),math.pi/2,Color3.fromRGB(120,60,50),rng,'sailor',5.4) local worker=Pose.createR15(folder,Vector3.new(-3,0,0),0,Color3.fromRGB(60,90,120),rng,'sailor',5.4) local fighter=Pose.createR15(folder,Vector3.new(3,0,0),0,Color3.fromRGB(90,50,50),rng,'sailor',5.6) local runner=Pose.createR15(folder,Vector3.new(9,0,0),0,Color3.fromRGB(50,90,60),rng,'sailor',5.6) if not (walker and worker and fighter and runner) then return 'LAB create failed' end _G.Lab={walker=walker,worker=worker,fighter=fighter,runner=runner} local fmF=FM.new(fighter,false) local fmR=FM.new(runner,false) local t0=os.clock() local wBase=walker:GetPivot() _G.LabConn=RunS.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)  local t=os.clock()-t0   local d=math.sin(t*0.5)*5  walker:PivotTo(wBase*CFrame.new(0,0,-d))  Pose.makeR15Action(walker,'walk',0,t*6)   Pose.work(worker,'hammer',t)    local phase=(t*0.9)%1  FM.actor(fmF,'ATTACK',phase,dt,false)  FM.actor(fmR,'RUN',(t*1.6)%1,dt,false) end) local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera cam.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable cam.FieldOfView=55 cam.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0,4.5,17),Vector3.new(0,3,0)) return 'LAB ok'

local L=_G.Lab local out={} local function foot(m) local r=m:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') local lf=m:FindFirstChild('LeftFoot',true) local rf=m:FindFirstChild('RightFoot',true) local lh=m:FindFirstChild('LeftHand',true) if not(r and lf and rf and lh) then return nil end local rel=function(p) return r.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(p.Position) end return rel(lf),rel(rf),rel(lh) end for name,m in L do  local mn,mx=1e9,-1e9 local hmn,hmx=1e9,-1e9  for i=1,12 do task.wait(0.12) local a,b,h=foot(m) if a then mn=math.min(mn,a.Z,b.Z) mx=math.max(mx,a.Z,b.Z) hmn=math.min(hmn,h.Y) hmx=math.max(hmx,h.Y) end end  out[#out+1]=string.format('MOTION %s footZ range=%.2f handY range=%.2f',name,mx-mn,hmx-hmn) end return table.concat(out,'\n')
